notes.title: This is It!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/987a57e30682565b1348c8208ff349eb5c16a029.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We did it! Surpassing $200K is an [b]incredible achievement[/b], and we couldn’t have done it without your overwhelming support. With just 2 hours left in the campaign, this is the final opportunity to jump in, secure your [b]exclusive rewards, and be part of something truly special.[/b]

If you've been waiting to pledge or upgrade your reward, [b]now is the time![/b]

[h1]Stretch Goal Hit: Advanced Weather System[/h1]
Thanks to your [b]incredible support[/b], we’ve unlocked the Advanced Weather System, which will bring the world of Forge of the Fae to life like [b]never before![/b] 🌧️⛈️

This system will add [b]dynamic weather[/b] to the world of Forge of the Fae, creating a [b]more immersive[/b] experience. Rain, storms, wind, fog, and frost will not only enhance the atmosphere but also impact gameplay in exciting ways. Whether it’s a storm rolling in during a pivotal moment or frost setting the tone for an icy morning, every day in the game will feel alive and unique. 😼

[h1]A Final Thank You[/h1]
Your enthusiasm, shares, and support have driven this campaign to heights we could only dream of. [b]Every single backer[/b] has played a role in shaping Forge of the Fae, and we can’t wait to deliver this [b]epic adventure[/b] to all of you.

With only a [b]couple of hours left[/b], let's hit this final stretch!! Share the campaign, encourage friends to join in, and let’s end this campaign on the highest note possible!❤️‍🔥

Thank you so much for believing in Forge of the Fae. You’ve made this journey [b]truly unforgettable[/b]. Let’s cross the finish line strong! 

Stay tuned for what's next~😻

notes.title: 3 Days Left + New Add On: Signed Physical OST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722821/bf6c9156db85f7f44d9ba43b89686ac0e64d25e4.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Hope you're all well. We're down to the final 3 days of the campaign and are absolutely thrilled with the results, energy and passion that you've all provided since day 1! 

As part of a way to keep that momentum and show our appreciation, we've managed to secure an exciting new add on.

[h1]Add On: Signed Physical OST[/h1]

Get a super exclusive physical copy of our OST CD signed by our composers, including Yoshino Aoki! This is a rare opportunity for something truly special. The Physical OST will also come with an illustrated cover image as well as a beautiful, fully illustrated booklet insert that outlines the tracks and includes thoughts from our composers on some of their inspirations and what the soundtrack means to them. If you're a music appreciator, don't miss out on this golden opportunity! 

As of writing we are only $7000 away from our next stretch goal, MORE YOSHINO AOKI! It's such a privilege to have her on this project, so let's show her our admiration and knock that stretch goal out of the park. 

Thousands of backers have already joined the adventure! Why not invite your friends to come along too? Share Forge of the Fae with fellow adventurers, and together we’ll unlock even more epic content! Thank you so much! ❤️

notes.title: Forge of the Fae Demo and Kickstarter are out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that [b]Forge of the Fae[/b] now has a playable demo! This [i]vertical slice[/i] offers a glimpse into our storytelling, exploration, combat, and world-building. It’s not just about nostalgia -- it’s a fresh, modern take on classic JRPGs.

[h2]Demo Features:[/h2]
[olist]
[*][b]Rich Storytelling:[/b] Join Fiora, Ceili, and Roark on a short but intriguing journey that sets the stage for greater mysteries.
[*][b]Dynamic Gameplay:[/b] Experience our strategic combat and explore the immersive world of [i]Forge of the Fae[/i].
[*][b]Stunning Visuals and Sound:[/b] Beautiful pixel art, day-night cycles, and an enchanting soundtrack complete the experience.
[/olist]

[h2]Crowdfunding[/h2]
This demo is just the beginning! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datadyne/forge-of-the-fae]Forge of the Fae is now live on Kickstarter[/url], and you’ll become part of the game-making process. Share your ideas, offer feedback, and help shape the final version of Forge of the Fae and leave your mark on this epic adventure. Together, we can create something unforgettable!
    
[previewyoutube=2x_k0225IyI;full][/previewyoutube]
